sentence: This project studies the geometric properties of conformal and quasiconformal mappings and how dimension and area change under holomorphic motions.
This project builds a simulation framework that helps computational scientists estimate the gains from running their applications on systems built from graphics processing units.
This project develops a graphene-based coating for lithium-ion battery cathodes to improve their durability, capacity and low-temperature performance.
This project studies the limitations of a way of learning to represent data so similar data are close together, to work on big data.
This project uses the Mexican tetra, a small fish, to find out how genes shape gut microbes and how those microbes affect fat storage.
This project develops techniques that help mobile robots navigate together among humans without collisions, by learning from how humans interact.
This project develops a low-cost way to monitor a braided river and to study whether it may change course and threaten salmon and villages.
This project studies how three histone writers work together to fine-tune gene expression and change how open or condensed the chromatin is.
This project develops advanced imaging techniques and microscopic probes to find out how biological cells respond to force.
This project studies how early farming changed plant and microbial communities at a site by studying fossil plant micro-remains and microbial DNA from sediment.
This project measures pore size and porosity with modern equipment and builds a material database from the collected data.
This project designs a computer chip that mimics human brains so deep brain stimulation for Parkinson's disease can be smaller and use less power.
This project develops programming-language techniques that check whether Bayesian inference programs written by users are sound and give good results.
This project calculates the energy of molecular clusters in the atmosphere that can form particles involved in cloud formation.
This project studies how treated effluent released into a dried river affects aquatic and riparian species and how their communities change.
This project brings together researchers to share advances in brain science and neurotechnology at a workshop.
This project studies defects that limit the coherence times of superconducting qubits by varying how the thin superconducting layers are grown.
